subcategory_text: Individuals are provided with mitigation mechanisms (e.g., credit monitoring, consent withdrawal, data alteration or deletion) to address impacts of problematic data actions.
informative_references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.30 (ICT readiness for business continuity)
GDPR Art. 17 (Right to erasure), Art. 18 (Right to restriction), Art. 21 (Right to object)
implementation_examples: Provide individuals with mitigation mechanisms (credit monitoring, consent withdrawal, data alteration, deletion) that address the impacts of problematic data actions
Document which mechanisms apply to which class of incident
Track the availability and outcome of mitigations offered
assessment_objectives: Determine whether mitigation mechanisms are offered to impacted individuals
Determine whether the mechanism-to-incident-class mapping is documented
Determine whether availability and outcomes of mitigations are tracked
Determine whether mitigations are communicated in plain language
